rows: Discuss whether your cats FCP and Rabies vaccines are current; these are core protections for cats in India.
FVRCP boosters are often given every 1–3 years depending on the vaccine and vet advice while rabies timing should follow local rules and the product label.
Ask your vet about LV only if your cat has exposure, such as outdoor access or contact with other cats of unknown status.
components.title: Vaccinations

rows: Use a vet-directed deworming and flea prevention plan; indoor cats can still pick up parasites through shoes, litter, shared spaces or prey exposure.
Many adult cats are dewormed about four times per year; your veterinarian may adjust this based on lifestyle and local risk.
components.title: Parasite prevention

rows: Feed a complete, balanced cat food with fresh water; milk is not a routine substitute for water. Support dental health with regular tooth brushing and annual mouth checks during wellness; your vet may recommend professional cleaning if plaque or tartar builds.
